name: Rui
source:
A humanoid who is the same height as Kikou. She has the special ability to suggest all five human senses, and even the sixth sense.

However, her original fighting style is hand-to-hand combat, and she possesses strong physical strength that does not match her appearance.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/react-kikou-7]official website[/url]]
